title: HART: Hybrid Attention-RWKV Time series Foundation Model
abstract: arXiv:2610.12883v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Non-autoregressive multi-step forecasting (NAF) enables time series foundation models to predict an entire future horizon in a single forward pass. Despite its strong sequence modeling capabilities, RWKV-7 exhibits long-horizon degradation in our NAF experiments. In this setup, future patches are represented as missing inputs, requiring the recurrent state to evolve across the prediction horizon without new observations. Our analysis of RWKV-7's generalized delta rule suggests a mechanism we term Placeholder Idling Decay (PID): repeated state transitions can attenuate historical information when placeholder-driven writes provide insufficient compensation. Layer-wise analysis reveals reduced state-injection norms in most layers, while transition-matrix norms remain similar between historical and prediction regions, consistent with PID. translated_title: HART：混合注意力-RWKV时间序列基础模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.12883v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：非自回归多步预测（NAF）使时间序列基础模型能够在单次前向传播中预测整个未来时间范围。尽管RWKV-7具有强大的序列建模能力，但在我们的NAF实验中，它表现出长时程退化。在这种设置下，未来补丁被表示为缺失输入，这要求循环状态在没有新观测的情况下在预测范围内持续演化。我们对RWKV-7广义增量规则的分析揭示了一种我们称之为占位符空转衰减（PID）的机制：当占位符驱动的写入无法提供足够补偿时，重复的状态转换会削弱历史信息。逐层分析显示，大多数层中的状态注入范数有所降低，而历史区域与预测区域之间的转换矩阵范数保持相似，这与PID机制相符。基于这一分析，我们提出了HART，一种混合注意力-RWKV时间序列基础模型……
tldr: 本文发现RWKV-7在非自回归多步预测中因“占位符空转衰减（PID）”机制导致历史信息被削弱而产生长时程退化，并据此提出了融合注意力机制与RWKV的混合时间序列基础模型HART来解决该问题。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies Placeholder Idling Decay (PID) as the cause of RWKV-7's long-horizon degradation in non-autoregressive multi-step forecasting, and proposes HART, a hybrid Attention-RWKV time series foundation model to address this issue.
